video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone selfie video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The man — a white man about 50 years old, bald head, a short reddish-grey goatee, sturdy build, wearing a red and black checkered flannel shirt — sits alone in a home garage workshop with a pegboard of tools behind him, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera, his head in the lower half of the frame. The phone rests steady; the camera stays still; the room around him stays still. He talks straight into the camera, serious and confident, like telling a friend a secret, with small natural head movements and calm shoulders.
